annex:p15.geometric-subsequence: floor x >= x/2, k(j)/alpha^j -> 1, geometric sum from j_0, pairwise variance additivity, Chebyshev, Tonelli interchange, Borel-Cantelli at countable thresholds 1/r. thm:p15-kronecker-lemma: conclusion, exact summation-by-parts identity, extended weight domain (a_n!=0, a_n->inf, eventually positive nondecreasing)

annex:p15.kronecker-lemma: identity derived by reindexing; q_{n,m} nonnegative with total mass one; explicit epsilon/M/H_M estimate (no division by an auxiliary bound); extended domain by shifting to the eventual tail and dividing the omitted finite head by a_n. Source checked: printed p.85 (PDF p.93) Thm 2.5.9 statement; printed p.86 (PDF p.94) summation by parts and averaging argument.

defect_observations.note: The 'positive infinite-mean strong law' (and at line 547 'the extended-mean strong law already proved') is invoked by description without a \ref; the result exists and is proved earlier on the route as thm:p15-extended-mean-strong-law (handbook/parts/p15/strong-law-applications.tex:36-48, annex/p15/strong-law-applications.tex:11-47). Does not affect any verdict.

'the bounded fourth-moment lemma', 'the countable threshold criterion' and 'the independent tail zero-one law' are cited by name only; they resolve to thm:p15-bounded-fourth-moment (independent-random-series.tex:97), thm:p15-event-limit-calculus (limsup-events-and-zero-one-laws.tex:40) and thm:p15-kolmogorov-tail-zero-one (limsup-events-and-zero-one-laws.tex:181). Does not affect any verdict.
'the generated-independence results' is an unlabeled reference; thm:p15-independent-blocks (independent-random-variables.tex:137-157) supplies it. Does not affect any verdict.

'Theorem thm:p15-layer-cake on the finite probability space' could be misread as a finite sample space; the cited corollary is stated for sigma-finite spaces and explicitly for any probability space. Does not affect any verdict.
'the reciprocal-square bound gives sum_{n>=m} n^-2 <= 2/m' does not name its source; the bound is Lemma thm:p15-power-tail-tools with q=2 (body lines 52-56). Does not affect any verdict.
